name: אינטגרל כפול של 1+f_x²+f_y² על מלבן – f ריבועית
questiontext:
עבור הפונקציה \( f(x,y)={{CT:0}} \), חשבו את 

\(\displaystyle{\iint_A 1+\left(f'_x(x,y)\right)^2+\left(f'_y(x,y)\right)^2\, dxdy}=\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

כאשר \( D={{CT:1}} \times{{CT:2}} \).

on_true.feedback:
Correct answer!

SInce \(f(x,y)=\){{CT:3}} is continuously differentiable on the rectangle \( D\) we can calculate the surface area of the graph on the rectangle D as such:

 \( \iint_{D}{ \sqrt{1+(\frac {\partial f}{\partial x}(x,y))^2+(\frac {\partial f}{\partial y}(x,y))^2}} dxdy= \int_{{{CT:4}}}^{{{CT:5}}}\left ({ \int_{{{CT:6}}}^{{{CT:7}}}{\sqrt{1+(\frac {\partial f}{\partial x}(x,y))^2+(\frac {\partial f}{\partial y}(x,y))^2}}}dx \right )dy= \)

 \( \int_{{{CT:4}}}^{{{CT:5}}}\left ({ \int_{{{CT:6}}}^{{{CT:7}}}{{{CT:8}}}}dx \right )dy={{CT:9}} \)
